name: Vampire Trials
source:
You are a vampire. One night after killing another one of your victims you've been seen by a peculiar girl. You would expect that she'd be terrified witnessing such a scene, however, to your surprise she's excited and asks you to make her a vampire too. You decide to give her a chance, but not before giving her some trials to judge her aptitude.

[From [url=https://ukigumosama.itch.io/vampire-trials]itch.io[/url]]
